quarterly_data.quarter: Daifuku results presentation: Consolidated Financial Results First Half of FY Ending December 31, 2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Daifuku H1 FY2026 (January-June 2026): orders received rose to ¥440.1 billion, driven primarily by cleanroom systems for semiconductor production lines, with intralogistics and automotive systems orders also rising; order backlogs exceeded JPY 740 billion, a new record high (741.1 billion yen at Q2). Orders, sales and all profit items reached first-half records.
quarterly_data.figure: orders ¥440.1 billion (+31.6%); order backlog 741.1 billion yen (exceeded JPY 740 billion)

quarterly_data.quarter: Daifuku results presentation: Consolidated Financial Results First Half of FY Ending December 31, 2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Daifuku H1 FY2026: net sales ¥355.5 billion (+8.9%) on higher sales of cleanroom systems and airport systems from the year-start order backlog; operating income ¥56.6 billion (+10.9%), driven by higher sales and improved profitability in cleanroom systems; operating margin 15.9% (+0.2pt).
quarterly_data.figure: net sales ¥355.5 billion (+8.9%); operating income ¥56.6 billion (+10.9%); operating margin 15.9%

quarterly_data.quarter: Daifuku results presentation: Consolidated Financial Results First Half of FY Ending December 31, 2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Daifuku segments, H1 FY2026: Clean Factomation orders rose to 64.0 billion yen from 35.5 billion, driven by an expansion in advanced semiconductor investments with increased demand for AI applications; its sales rose to 40.0 billion yen from 18.8 billion and segment income to 7.3 billion yen from 1.5 billion. Daifuku (Suzhou) Cleanroom Automation orders rose to 24.9 billion yen from 14.0 billion. The Other segment's orders and sales rose mainly on cleanroom systems.
quarterly_data.figure: Clean Factomation orders 64.0 billion yen (vs 35.5), sales 40.0 billion yen (vs 18.8); Daifuku (Suzhou) Cleanroom Automation orders 24.9 billion yen (vs 14.0)

quarterly_data.signal: Daifuku orders by industry and destination, H1 FY2026: Electronics orders 203.2 billion yen (46.2% of total) vs 116.6 billion a year earlier; by destination, Taiwan orders 74.8 billion yen (vs 45.5), South Korea 65.1 billion yen (vs 39.2) and China 55.7 billion yen (vs 34.4).
quarterly_data.figure: Electronics orders 203.2 billion yen (46.2%); Taiwan 74.8, South Korea 65.1, China 55.7 billion yen

quarterly_data.quarter: Daifuku results presentation: Consolidated Financial Results First Half of FY Ending December 31, 2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Daifuku raised its FY2026 (year ending December 31, 2026) forecast, supported by the continued strong business environment, particularly in cleanroom systems: orders received ¥860.0~900.0 billion (from 780.0~820.0), net sales ¥735.0 billion (from 700.0), operating income ¥113.0 billion (from 105.0), operating margin 15.4%; all expected to reach new record highs. The sales revision reflects smooth progress in cleanroom-system projects underpinned by the year-start order backlog and earlier-than-expected revenue recognition for certain projects.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 orders ¥860.0~900.0 billion; net sales ¥735.0 billion; operating income ¥113.0 billion; OP margin 15.4%

quarterly_data.quarter: Daifuku results presentation: Consolidated Financial Results First Half of FY Ending December 31, 2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Daifuku management: the Middle East situation has limited direct impact (no production or sales sites in the region; under 0.1% of consolidated net sales), but the company continues to monitor supply constraints and rising costs for certain materials from higher crude oil prices and disrupted international logistics affecting orders already received, and trends in customers' investment plans.
quarterly_data.figure: sales exposure less than 0.1% of consolidated net sales
